releaseNotes: Chats open at the newest message and viewing them clears both unread counters and presented notifications.
Long-press enters Telegram-style multi-selection with reply, forward, pin and delete actions.
Deletion supports separate choices for this device account or everyone in the conversation.
Double-tap adds a heart reaction and reaction badges no longer display numeric counts.
Photo attachments support reliable 1–6x pinch zoom, pan, double-tap zoom and download.
Voice recording shows a live microphone-driven waveform and elapsed time.
Voice settings can request the phone, automatic or Android speakerphone communication microphone route.
Android status and three-button navigation areas are treated as hard UI boundaries.
